verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yaa-seen
Wal-qur'aanil-hakeem
Innaka laminal-mursaleen
Alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Tanzeelal-azeezir-Raheem
Litundhira qawman maa undhira aabaa'uuhum fahum ghaafiloon
Laqad haqqal-qawlu alaa aktharihim fahum laa yu'minoon
Innaa ja'alnaa fee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal-adhqaani fahum muqmahoon
Wa ja'alnaa min bayni aydeehim saddan wa min khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynaahum fahum laa yubsiroon
Wa sawaa'un alayhim a'andhartahum am lam tundhirhum laa yu'minoon
Innamaa tundhiru manit-taba'adh-dhikra wa khashiyar-Rahmaana bil-ghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin wa ajrin kareem
Innaa nahnu nuhyil-mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aathaarahum wa kulla shay'in hsaynaahu fee imaamin mubeen
Wadrib lahum mathalan ashaabal-qaryati idh jaa'ahal-mursaloon
Idh arsalnaa ilayhimu ithnayni fakadhdhaboohumaa fa-azzaznaa bithaalithin faqaaloo innaa ilaykum mursaloon
Qaaloo maa antum illaa basharun mithlunaa wa maa anzalar-Rahmaanu min shay'in in antum illaa takdhiboon
Qaaloo rabbunaa ya'lamu innaa ilaykum lamursaloon
Wa maa alaynaa illal-balaaghul-mubeen
Qaaloo innaa tatayyarnaa bikum la-in lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum wa layamassannakum minnaa adhaabun aleem
Qaaloo taa'irukum ma'akum a'in dhukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoon
Wa jaa'a min aqsal-madeenati rajulun yas'aa qaala yaa qawmi ittabi'ul-mursaleen
Ittabi'oo man laa yas'alukum ajran wa hum muhtadoon
Wa maa liya laa a'budul-ladhee fataranee wa ilayhi turja'oon
A'attakhidhu min doonihi aalihatan in yuridnir-Rahmaanu bidurrin laa tughni annee shafaa'atuhum shay'an wa laa yunqidhoon
Innee idhan lafee dalaalin mubeen
Innee aamantu birabbikum fasma'oon
Qeelad-khulil-jannata qaala yaa layta qawmee ya'lamoon
Bimaa ghafara lee rabbee wa ja'alanee minal-mukrameen
Wa maa anzalnaa alaa qawmihi min ba'dihi min jundin minas-samaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
In kaanat illaa sayhatan waahidatan fa-idhaa hum khaamidoon
Yaa hasratan alal-ibaadi maa ya'teehim min rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Alam yaraw kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal-qurooni annahum ilayhim laa yarji'oon
Wa in kullun lammaa jamee'un ladaynaa muhdaroon
Wa aayatun lahumul-ardul-maytatu ahyaynaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu ya'kuloon
Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatin min nakheelin wa a'naabin wa fajjarnaa feehaa minal-uyoon
Liya'kuloo min thamarihi wa maa amilathu aydeehim afalaa yashkuroon
Subhaanal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tunbitul-ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
Wa aayatun lahumul-laylu naslakhu minhun-nahaara fa-idhaa hum muzlimoon
Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarrin lahaa dhaalika taqdeerul-azeezil-aleem
Wal-qamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa aada kal-urjoonil-qadeem
Lash-shamsu yanbaghee lahaa an tudrikal-qamara wa lal-laylu saabiqun-nahaari wa kullun fee falakin yasbahoon
Wa aayatun lahum annaa hamalnaa dhurriyyatahum fil-fulkil-mashhoon
Wa khalaqnaa lahum min mithlihi maa yarkaboon
Wa in nasha nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqadhoon
Illaa rahmatan minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
Wa idhaa qeela lahumu ittaqoo maa bayna aydeekum wa maa khalfakum la-allakum turhamoon
Wa maa ta'teehim min aayatin min aayaati rabbihim illaa kaanoo anhaa mu'rideen
Wa idhaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumu Allaahu qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo anut'imu man law yashaa'u Allaahu at'amahu in antum illaa fee dalaalin mubeen
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Maa yanzuroona illaa sayhatan waahidatan ta'khudhuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
Falaa yastatee'oona tawsiyatan wa laa ilaa ahlihim yarji'oon
Wa nufikha fis-soori fa-idhaa hum minal-ajdaathi ilaa rabbihim yansiloon
Qaaloo yaa waylanaa man ba'athanaa min marqadinaa haadhaa maa wa-adar-Rahmaanu wa sadaqal-mursaloon
In kaanat illaa sayhatan waahidatan fa-idhaa hum jamee'un ladaynaa muhdaroon
Fal-yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shay'an wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
Inna ashaabal-jannatil-yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin alal-araa'iki muttaki'oon
Lahum feehaa faakihatun wa lahum maa yadda'oon
Salaamun qawlan min rabbin Raheem
Wamtaazul-yawma ayyuhal-mujrimoon
Alam a'had ilaykum yaa banee aadama an laa ta'budush-shaytaana innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen
Wa ani-budoonee haadhaa siraatun mustaqeem
Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
Haadhihi jahannamul-latee kuntum too'adoon
Islawhal-yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Al-yawma nakhtimu alaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaa aydeehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Wa law nashaa'u latamasnaa alaa a'yunihim fastabaqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
Wa law nashaa'u lamasakhnaahum alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyan wa laa yarji'oon
Wa man nu'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalqi afalaa ya'qiloon
Wa maa allamnaahush-shi'ra wa maa yanbaghee lahu in huwa illaa dhikrun wa qur'aanun mubeen
Liyundhira man kaana hayyan wa yahiqqal-qawlu alal-kaafireen
Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa amilat aydeenaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
Wa dhallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa ya'kuloon
Wa lahum feehaa manaafi'u wa mashaaribu afalaa yashkuroon
Wattakhadhoo min doonillaahi aalihatan la-allahum yunsaroon
Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundun muhdaroon
Falaa yahzunka qawluhum innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
Awalam yaral-insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-idhaa huwa khaseemun mubeen
Wa daraba lanaa mathalan wa nasiya khalqahu qaala man yuhyil-izaama wa hiya rameem
Qul yuhyeehal-ladhee ansha'ahaa awwala marratin wa huwa bikulli khalqin aleem
Al-ladhee ja'ala lakum minash-shajaril-akhdari naaran fa-idhaa antum minhu tooqidoon
Awalaysal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda biqaadirin alaa an yakhluqa mithlahum balaa wa huwal-khallaaqul-aleem
Innamaa amruhu idhaa araada shay'an an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoon
Fasubhaanal-ladhee biyadihi malakootu kulli shay'in wa ilayhi turja'oon
